description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No.1834/01 of 28.08.2013,  Rathmalana D/S Division, Colombo District  - Cad. Map No.  521005
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains specific details about parcels of land, including parcel numbers, block numbers, cadastral maps, village locations, Grama Niladhari divisions, and amendments to land title particulars such as ownership details, access rights, servitude rights, and corrections to parcel numbers and extents. The content is purely land and property-related, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
